blocks.html: Ah, 4/20—the unofficial holiday for cannabis enthusiasts worldwide. Whether you're a seasoned stoner or a casual toker, there's no denying the appeal of kicking back, rolling up, and enjoying some quality entertainment. And what better way to celebrate than with a lineup of weed-centric movies that are sure to elevate your viewing experience? Grab your favorite strain, settle into your comfiest spot, and get ready to dive into the best cannabis-themed films to enhance your 4/20 celebration.

This stoner classic follows the misadventures of process server Dale Denton (Seth Rogen) and his pot dealer Saul Silver (James Franco) after witnessing a murder linked to a rare strain of marijuana called Pineapple Express. Filled with hilarious antics, action-packed sequences, and plenty of cannabis-induced shenanigans, "Pineapple Express" is a must-watch for any 4/20 celebration.

When it comes to iconic weed-centric comedies, "Half Baked" reigns supreme. Written by and starring Dave Chappelle, the film follows a group of friends who embark on a series of outrageous schemes to raise money for their friend's bail after he's arrested for accidentally killing a diabetic police horse by feeding it junk food. With memorable characters, quotable lines, and a generous dose of irreverent humor, "Half Baked" is guaranteed to have you in stitches.

Set on the last day of school in 1976, "Dazed and Confused" offers a nostalgic glimpse into the world of high schoolers as they navigate relationships, rebellion, and, of course, cannabis. Directed by Richard Linklater, the film features an ensemble cast of rising stars, including Matthew McConaughey, Ben Affleck, and Parker Posey. With its laid-back vibe, killer soundtrack, and coming-of-age themes, "Dazed and Confused" is the perfect companion for a chill 4/20 celebration.

No list of weed-centric movies would be complete without "The Big Lebowski." Directed by the Coen Brothers, this cult classic follows the Dude (Jeff Bridges), a laid-back slacker who gets embroiled in a bizarre kidnapping plot after being mistaken for a millionaire with the same name. Filled with eccentric characters, surreal humor, and plenty of White Russians, "The Big Lebowski" is a trippy, offbeat masterpiece that's best enjoyed with a joint in hand.

Considered the ultimate stoner comedy, "Up in Smoke" stars Cheech Marin and Tommy Chong as two hapless stoners who unwittingly become involved in a series of misadventures while searching for the perfect batch of marijuana. Packed with memorable scenes, quotable lines, and an infectious soundtrack, "Up in Smoke" remains a timeless classic that captures the spirit of 4/20 like no other.

Whether you're looking for belly laughs, nostalgic vibes, or mind-bending thrills, these weed-centric movies are sure to enhance your 4/20 celebration. So grab your favorite strain, fire up the popcorn, and get ready for a cinematic journey that's guaranteed to leave you feeling blissfully elevated. Happy 4/20, and may your day be filled with good vibes and great movies!
